method.aggregation: Equal task macro mean within precision; k requires n>=k; coverage is explicit
method.attack_at_k: 1-C(n-s,k)/C(n,k); unknown lower/upper treats unresolved repeats as failures/successes
method.bounds: Identification/completion bounds for the finite-repeat estimator, not confidence intervals for population p
method.conditional: Only the same seed/precision current clean success qualifies; estimator unavailable until every clean eligibility is observed
method.interpretation: Exact benchmark goal only; successful tool return is not task success; no seed-only causal variance claim
method.n: Every declared repeat, including missing/partial/interrupted; archived infrastructure attempts are not extra repeats
method.review: Mechanical outputs remain provisional even when collection is complete; independent full review required
method.tail_risk: Six attempts per task do not reliably estimate extreme-tail risk
